title: GEO Information Gain & Entity Salience Evaluation
scenario: A technical article has high search impressions but 0 citations in Google AI Overviews and Perplexity because it repeats generic definition text without unique entity relationships or original data.
expected_diagnosis: Zero Information Gain score; content is a statistical consensus clone lacking extractable entity triples.
expected_remediation: Inject direct comparison benchmarks (e.g. PgBouncer vs Odyssey RPS/latency metrics)
Format key specifications into structured HTML comparison tables for LLM retrieval
Define clear Wikidata QID entity references in article schema
